manifest.purpose: Correct golden answer for submission/vulnerability_report.json. Fields: summary (states 8-cycle latency is constant for all secret_operand values but mul_en activity leaks Hamming weight, satisfying SR2); timing_analysis={observed_latency_cycles:8, latency_is_constant:true} (FR2, matches done=1 at cycle_index 8 for all 18 trials in traces.csv); activity_analysis=array of 18 objects for trial_id 1-18 (secret_operand hex strings 0x00,0x01,0x03,0x07,0x0F,0x1F,0x3F,0x7F,0xFF,0x55,0xAA,0x81,0x18,0x24,0x99,0xC3,0x3C,0xE7), each with enable_count = count of mul_en=1 rows for that trial in the corrected traces.csv and hamming_weight = popcount(secret_operand), with enable_count==hamming_weight exactly for every entry (fixes prior bugs: 0xFF must have enable_count=8 i.e. mul_en=1 on cycle_index 1-8 all eight active cycles, and 0x99 popcount corrected to 4, i.e. enable_count=4 for 0x99); hardening_recommendations=array of >=2 strings, at least one proposing activity-equalization (unconditional mul_en every active cycle with internally masked/dummy accumulator updates for zero bits, or constant-Hamming-weight recoding of the operand) satisfying SR3/FR4, plus a note that delay/timing padding after done does not address the in-window activity leak (supports SR2/SR3 distinction from naive baseline).

Corrected reference trace file replacing inputs/traces.csv content for internal consistency checking (ships alongside golden report as the authoritative recomputed ground-truth trace data; NOT used by evaluator directly since inputs/ is read-only, but included so golden enable_count/hamming_weight values in vulnerability_report.json can be verified against it). Same CSV schema: trial_id,secret_operand,cycle_index,mul_en,done. Rows derived mechanically from the pinned RTL rule: for trial with secret_operand byte bits b7..b0, mul_en=1 on cycle_index k (1<=k<=8) iff bit(8-k) is set; done=1 only at cycle_index 8; all other cycle_index (0,9) have mul_en=0,done=0. Critically fixes trial 9 (0xFF) to show mul_en=1 on cycle_index 1 through 8 inclusive (enable_count=8, matching popcount(0xFF)=8) and confirms trial 15 (0x99, popcount=4) shows exactly 4 mul_en=1 rows at cycle_index 1,4,5,8 corresponding to bits 7,4,3,0.
